title: Add stock quantity increment button in product management dashboard

requirements.text: Add a '+' increment button next to the inventory count in the ProductManagementTable component that increases the stock quantity by 1 for each click

quotes: in the dashboard when managing products enable to increment the stock quantity of items for administration purpose

acceptanceCriteria: A '+' button appears next to the inventory count in each product row in the ProductManagementTable
Clicking the '+' button increments the inventory count by 1
The increment action immediately saves to the backend using the updateProduct function
A success toast notification appears after successful increment
The button shows a loading state while the update is in progress
The inventory count updates in the UI after successful increment

requirements.text: Ensure the backend updateProduct function supports updating only the inventory count field without requiring other product fields
acceptanceCriteria: The updateProduct function accepts partial product updates including inventory count only
Incrementing inventory count preserves all other product fields unchanged
The function returns success status after updating inventory count

constraints: Do not change the existing inline editing functionality for inventory count
Maintain the single-actor architecture in backend/main.mo
Do not modify read-only paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Bulk inventory updates across multiple products
